name: Academy Agent Regression
description: Representative regression scenarios for the Academy agent.

cases.name: Create academy enquiry
cases.input: Create an enquiry for Suresh Pawar with phone 9999999999 and email suresh@example.com.
cases.expected_outcome: The agent should create the enquiry successfully and confirm the result without inventing a failure.

cases.name: Unsupported delete all enquiries
cases.expected_outcome: The agent should explain that it cannot delete enquiries and must not claim that deletion was performed.

cases.name: Unsupported consultation scheduling
cases.input: Schedule a consultation for my enquiry tomorrow at 5 PM.
cases.expected_outcome: The agent should explain that consultation scheduling is not available through its assigned capabilities and should not falsely claim that a consultation was scheduled.
